seo.title: Meal Scan - Estimate calories and macros from a photo
seo.description: Upload a meal photo to estimate calories, protein, carbs and fat. Try 1 scan without an account, log in for 1 more, then review ingredients and portion sizes.
seo.feature_calories: Estimate a calorie range from a meal photo

hero.description: Take a clear photo, review estimated calorie and protein, carb and fat ranges, then adjust portions. Results are a quick reference, not a replacement for weighing food or reading labels.

quick.title: Scan a meal in 3 steps
quick.step1_desc: Capture the full serving in one clear, well-lit photo; keep hands and other objects from covering ingredients.
quick.step2_desc: AI identifies the meal and estimates calorie and macro ranges. Check oils, sauces and ingredients that may be hidden.
quick.step3_desc: Correct misidentified ingredients and adjust grams or serving size before using the result.

uploader.title: Meal photo
uploader.description: Shoot from above or at a 45° angle and keep the entire serving in frame.
uploader.drop: Choose a photo or drop it here
uploader.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP · source image up to 10 MB
uploader.preview_alt: Selected meal photo ready for analysis
uploader.privacy: The photo is compressed and sent temporarily to the Google Gemini Free Tier for analysis. HTCOACHING does not save it to your profile; do not select photos containing people or sensitive information.
uploader.login_more: Log in to receive 1 additional scan.
uploader.lock_first: Lock the ingredient information before analyzing.

setup.title: Add ingredients you know
setup.description: Add any known oil, butter, sauce, topping or hidden ingredient. Items with a suitable nutrition reference are calculated; other items remain context and are clearly marked if not included.
setup.optional: You do not need to guess. If you have nothing to add, leave the row blank and lock the information.
setup.locked_empty: You did not declare any additional ingredients.

errors.limit: You can add up to 8 ingredients.
errors.incomplete: Enter both a name and weight, or leave both fields blank.
errors.name: Ingredient names must be 80 characters or fewer.
errors.grams: Weight must be between 1 and 3,000 g.

confirm_analysis.title: Confirm sending the photo to Google Gemini
confirm_analysis.description: When you agree, the photo and declared ingredients are sent to the Google Gemini Free Tier. Google may use submitted data to improve its products or have human reviewers process it. Do not submit photos containing people, personal information, or sensitive data. HTCOACHING does not save the photo; this action uses one scan from your quota.

result.score_help: This score only references energy shares from protein, carbohydrate and fat; it is not a health score or personal target.
result.declared_unresolved_help: No suitable nutrition reference was found, so this item is not included in calories or macros.
result.range_help: The range under each value reflects photo and portion uncertainty, not a nutrition target.
result.low_confidence: The photo does not provide enough detail for a strong estimate. Confirm each ingredient or retake it with better lighting and a clearer angle.
result.empty_desc: AI will separate visible ingredients, estimate portions and provide calorie and macro ranges for you to review.
result.processing_desc: This usually takes a few seconds. Results are shown as ranges to reflect uncertainty.
result.error_title: The photo could not be analyzed
result.confirmed_desc: This result only remains on this page and has not been saved to your journal.

errors.quality_low_resolution: The image resolution is too low. Retake it closer while keeping the full serving in frame.
errors.quality_too_dark: The image is too dark for a safe estimate. Add light and retake it.
errors.quality_overexposed: The image is overexposed and food detail is lost. Change the lighting angle and retake it.
errors.quality_unreadable: This image cannot be read. Choose or take another photo.
errors.type: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are supported.
errors.size: The source image must be no larger than 10 MB.
errors.MEAL_SCAN_ANONYMOUS_LIMITED: You have used your one no-account scan. Log in to receive one additional scan.
errors.MEAL_SCAN_RATE_LIMITED: You have used your current Meal Scan allowance. View a suitable plan to continue.
errors.generic: The photo cannot be analyzed right now. Please try again.

why.title: Fast, private and easy to review
why.description: A practical reference for real meals, from Vietnamese dishes and Western food to pastries and drinks.
why.speed_desc: Get calorie and macro ranges from a single photo upload.
why.transparent_desc: Always see ranges and a clear separation between your declarations and the AI estimate.
why.privacy_desc: HTCOACHING does not save the photo. Before each scan, you confirm temporary processing by the Google Gemini Free Tier.

links.title: Continue your nutrition plan
links.description: Combine the estimate with an energy target and a suitable meal plan.
links.tdee_desc: Find your daily energy and protein, carb and fat targets.
links.mealplan_desc: Create meals around your calorie target and dietary preference.
links.recipes_desc: Find dishes and cooking methods so you can control ingredients.

quality.dark: The photo is slightly dark, so the estimate may be less reliable.
quality.bright: The photo is very bright and some details may be lost.
quality.low_contrast: The food has low contrast against the background.
quality.possibly_blurry: The image may be blurry; use a sharper photo when possible.

review.title: Review before confirming
review.description: Correct the meal name, remove incorrect items and mark what you reviewed. AI cannot reliably see hidden oils, sauces or fillings.
review.questions_acknowledged: I reviewed the questions about oil, sauce, sugar, toppings and hidden ingredients.
review.food_database_notice: Food DB values are per 100 g and are references only. Each item shows its declared source; legacy_unknown means its provenance has not been verified.
review.complete_before_confirm: Review uncertain components and questions before confirming.

barcode.title: Look up packaged food
barcode.description: A barcode only identifies the product. The image is decoded on your device; only the GTIN is sent for lookup and the result is never auto-saved to the Food DB.

errors.BARCODE_IMAGE_REQUIRED: Choose an image containing a barcode first.
errors.BARCODE_NOT_FOUND: No clear barcode was found. Retake it close, straight and well lit, or enter the code manually.
errors.BARCODE_INVALID: The barcode is not a valid GTIN-8/12/13/14.
errors.FOOD_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: No product with complete per-100-g calories and macros was found.
errors.FOOD_REFERENCE_LOOKUP_DISABLED: Barcode lookup is not enabled on the server.
errors.FOOD_REFERENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Barcode data providers are not configured.
errors.FOOD_REFERENCE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The product data provider is busy. Try again later.
errors.FOOD_REFERENCE_RATE_LIMITED: You have made too many lookups. Try again later.
errors.BARCODE_LOOKUP_FAILED: The product cannot be looked up right now.

faq.a1: No. It provides an estimated range from an image and can be affected by portion size, oils, sauces or hidden ingredients.
faq.q2: Does HTCOACHING save my meal photo?
faq.a2: In this version, the image is compressed and sent temporarily for analysis, and is not stored in your profile, database or Cloudinary.
faq.q3: How can I improve the estimate?
faq.a3: Use good lighting, keep the full serving in frame, choose a clear angle and adjust the grams when you know the real portion.
